item.tib: zhing skyong seng gdong khros ma'i sgrub pa mthar phyin rjes kyi dgos pa byin rlabs myur byed
item.coloph: zhes pa'ang 'di ni zhing skyongs chen mo bsgrab pa'i mthar phyin rjes kyi dgos pa shin tu zab cing byin rlabs myur byed zhes pa/shing yos lor mkha' 'gro'i 'du gnas shel brag rtse drug gnas su/ rje mtshungs med g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gyi thugs sras bshes gnyen rin chen bkra shis/ zhing skyongs bsgrub la bzhugs rjes 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ o rgyan thugs sras 'chi med rig 'dzin byang chub snying po bde ba'i rdo rje rtsal gyis/ kun dga' skyed tshal sgrub pa'i thun mtshams su sbyar ba bkra shis dge legs 'phel//
